algebra.aggregation: Sum norm-squares/inner products over exact fixed set; global cosine uses summed inner and global norms,not mean cosines
algebra.difference: Equal rank: QR of Bj(sjAj-siAi)+(Bj-Bi)siAi; unequal rank: concatenated factor QR; avoids squared-norm cancellation
algebra.energy90: Smallest k reaching90% squared singular-value energy
algebra.negative_squared_norm: QR/SVD distances nonnegative; independent Gram negative may only clamp within declared64eps error bound,otherwise fail
algebra.precision: Lossless BF16→FP32 cache→FP64 CPU accumulation; cannot undo quantization
algebra.zero_policy: Retain raw norm and bound; numerical zero if raw<=64*eps64*r*||A||F*||B||F, exact factor-zero separately; no exact product equality claimed from tolerance

missing_rule: Explicit missing/failed units; fixed100-module global denominator cannot silently change
